intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A floating marker keeps bumping the waterside stone. Nerelle is counting the bumps.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Your clock tower claims every hour is the same length. I have been checking.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Poorly. The tide has filed a dissent.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “At home, we ask the moon what time it is. In emergencies, a very old crab.”

options.labelText: “Keep the crab. The tower can have the meetings.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “A sensible treaty. I will inform the crab.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “He has been anxious about his position.”

options.labelText: “We could merge them. One clock, with the tides as a recurring event.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Splendid. Please inform the moon before the council.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The marker bumps the stone again. By the tower’s reckoning, it is late.
